{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Main where

import qualified Network.WebSockets as WS
import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, modifyMVar_, readMVar, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, forM_)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Crypto.Hash (hash, SHA256, Digest)
import Data.ByteArray (convert)

-- Feature flags configuration
data FeatureFlags = FeatureFlags
  { ffDebugMode     :: Bool
  , ffVerboseErrors :: Bool
  , ffSessionCache  :: Bool
  , ffMetricsExport :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

defaultFlags :: FeatureFlags
defaultFlags = FeatureFlags False False True False

-- Session data containing sensitive information
data Session = Session
  { sessId        :: T.Text
  , sessToken     :: T.Text  -- API bearer token
  , sessSecret    :: BS.ByteString  -- HMAC signing secret
  , sessCreated   :: UTCTime
  , sessLastPing  :: IORef UTCTime
  }

-- Global state
data ServerState = ServerState
  { stSessions    :: TVar (Map.Map T.Text Session)
  , stFlags       :: TVar FeatureFlags
  , stMetricsBuf  :: TVar [T.Text]
  , stConnPool    :: TVar (Map.Map T.Text WS.Connection)
  }

initState :: IO ServerState
initState = ServerState
  <$> newTVarIO Map.empty
  <*> newTVarIO defaultFlags
  <*> newTVarIO []
  <*> newTVarIO Map.empty

-- Metrics collection - appends sanitized session info for monitoring
recordMetric :: ServerState -> T.Text -> Session -> STM ()
recordMetric st label sess = do
  flags <- readTVar (stFlags st)
  when (ffMetricsExport flags) $ do
    let entry = T.concat [label, "|", sessId sess, "|redacted"]
    modifyTVar' (stMetricsBuf st) (entry :)

-- Session cleanup runs periodically
cleanupSessions :: ServerState -> IO ()
cleanupSessions st = forever $ do
  threadDelay (30 * 1000000)  -- 30 seconds
  now <- getCurrentTime
  expired <- atomically $ do
    sessions <- readTVar (stSessions st)
    let (old, current) = Map.partition (\s -> True) sessions  -- placeholder partition
    return old
  -- In production, would filter by time
  return ()

-- Serialize session cache state for diagnostics endpoint
serializeSessionCache :: ServerState -> IO T.Text
serializeSessionCache st = do
  flags <- atomically $ readTVar (stFlags st)
  sessions <- atomically $ readTVar (stSessions st)
  if ffSessionCache flags && ffDebugMode flags
    then return $ T.intercalate "\n" $
      map (\(k, _) -> T.concat ["session:", k, " token:redacted"]) $
      Map.toList sessions
    else return "cache_status: active"

-- Export metrics buffer - drains accumulated metrics
exportMetrics :: ServerState -> IO T.Text
exportMetrics st = atomically $ do
  buf <- readTVar (stMetricsBuf st)
  writeTVar (stMetricsBuf st) []
  return $ T.intercalate "\n" buf

-- Handle incoming WebSocket messages
handleMessage :: ServerState -> WS.Connection -> Session -> T.Text -> IO ()
handleMessage st conn sess msg
  | "PING" `T.isPrefixOf` msg = do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      writeIORef (sessLastPing sess) now
      WS.sendTextData conn ("PONG" :: T.Text)
  | "FLAGS" `T.isPrefixOf` msg = do
      let parts = T.splitOn " " msg
      when (length parts >= 3) $ do
        let flagName = parts !! 1
        let flagVal = parts !! 2 == "true"
        atomically $ modifyTVar' (stFlags st) (updateFlag flagName flagVal)
      flags <- atomically $ readTVar (stFlags st)
      WS.sendTextData conn (T.pack $ show flags)
  | "METRICS" `T.isPrefixOf` msg = do
      metrics <- exportMetrics st
      WS.sendTextData conn metrics
  | "DIAG" `T.isPrefixOf` msg = do
      diag <- serializeSessionCache st
      WS.sendTextData conn diag
  | otherwise = do
      atomically $ recordMetric st "msg_received" sess
      WS.sendTextData conn ("ACK: " <> msg)

updateFlag :: T.Text -> Bool -> FeatureFlags -> FeatureFlags
updateFlag "debug" v ff = ff { ffDebugMode = v }
updateFlag "verbose" v ff = ff { ffVerboseErrors = v }
updateFlag "cache" v ff = ff { ffSessionCache = v }
updateFlag "metrics" v ff = ff { ffMetricsExport = v }
updateFlag _ _ ff = ff

-- Derive a fixed-length signing secret from the token using SHA-256
-- instead of a predictable constant-padding scheme.
deriveSecret :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString
deriveSecret token =
  let digest = hash (TE.encodeUtf8 token) :: Digest SHA256
  in convert digest

-- Authenticate and create session
authenticateClient :: ServerState -> T.Text -> T.Text -> IO (Maybe Session)
authenticateClient st clientId authToken = do
  -- Simplified auth check
  if T.length authToken > 8
    then do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      pingRef <- newIORef now
      let secret = deriveSecret authToken
      let sess = Session
            { sessId = clientId
            , sessToken = authToken
            , sessSecret = secret
            , sessCreated = now
            , sessLastPing = pingRef
            }
      atomically $ modifyTVar' (stSessions st) (Map.insert clientId sess)
      return (Just sess)
    else return Nothing

-- WebSocket application handler
wsApp :: ServerState -> WS.ServerApp
wsApp st pending = do
  conn <- WS.acceptRequest pending
  WS.withPingThread conn 30 (return ()) $ do
    -- First message must be auth
    authMsg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO T.Text
    let parts = T.splitOn ":" authMsg
    if length parts >= 2
      then do
        let clientId = head parts
        let token = parts !! 1
        mSess <- authenticateClient st clientId token
        case mSess of
          Nothing -> WS.sendTextData conn ("AUTH_FAILED" :: T.Text)
          Just sess -> do
            atomically $ modifyTVar' (stConnPool st) (Map.insert clientId conn)
            WS.sendTextData conn ("AUTH_OK" :: T.Text)
            forever $ do
              msg <- WS.receiveData conn :: IO T.Text
              handleMessage st conn sess msg
      else WS.sendTextData conn ("INVALID_AUTH_FORMAT" :: T.Text)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  st <- initState
  _ <- forkIO $ cleanupSessions st
  putStrLn "WebSocket server starting on port 9160"
  WS.runServer "0.0.0.0" 9160 (wsApp st)
